card.name: Words that introduce a list of items
card.fires_on: Mostly the verb or linking word 'include' or 'including' just before a list of treatments or components, as in 'screening should include'. It also fires on a few other linking words such as 'to' and 'of' in clinical text.

modes.label: Include before a list
modes.description: The word include or including opens a list of treatments or assessment parts.
modes.example: such screening should<< include>> a detailed psychiatric history, including a family
